meta.name: experiment-readout
meta.description: 假设 + 指标 + 结果 + 解释 + 决策, 把 A/B 或产品实验转成行动建议

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把实验数据转化为可执行的行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常分析产品实验并需要清晰的下一步行动
copy.tagline_en: Turn experiment data into actionable recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze product experiments and need clear next steps

howto.what: 把你给的 A/B 或产品实验材料转成一份实验复盘报告:包含改写后的假设、指标对照表、结果解释,并给出上线 / 迭代 / 延长 / 停止的决策和后续实验建议。
howto.when: 当你提供 A/B test、增长实验或灰度实验的数据(markdown、CSV、表格粘贴皆可)并要求复盘时接管。

say.text: 这是我的 A/B 实验结果,帮我写一份实验复盘
say.note: 输出带决策的复盘报告

say.text: 用 lab-notebook 风格复盘这个灰度实验
say.note: 换成实验室 notebook 样式

say.text: 样本量只有 200,别把结论写得太确定
say.note: 结果会标为 directional 并加 caveat

howto.what_en: Turns your A/B or product experiment material into an experiment readout: a rewritten hypothesis, metric table, result interpretation, a ship/iterate/extend/stop decision, and 2-4 follow-up experiments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you hand over A/B test, growth, or rollout experiment data (markdown, CSV, or pasted tables) and ask for a readout.

say_en.text: Here's my A/B test result - write the experiment readout
say_en.note: Produces a readout with a decision

say_en.text: Redo this rollout readout in lab-notebook style
say_en.note: Switches to the lab notebook style

say_en.text: Only 200 samples - don't overstate the result
say_en.note: Marks it directional and adds caveats
